name: Cross-section Texture Synthesis with Flow Vectors
aliases: Interactive system for designing and browsing volumetric illustrations
definition: A method to synthesize cross-sectional images for 3D models by mapping pixels from a 2D control map (containing flow vectors) to a reference volume, ensuring the synthesized texture matches the local neighborhood structure and orientation defined by the flow.
summary: Cross-section Texture Synthesis with Flow Vectors generates internal textures for 3D models by mapping 2D reference images to cross-sections using flow vectors to guide sampling geometry, supporting layered and oriented structures unlike isotropic methods.
